title: Senathipathi
desc: Sethupathi, a young man, falls in love with Lingappan Naicker, the village head's daughter Aishwarya. Meanwhile, the girl's father asks Senathipathi, Sethu's older brother, to protect her.

title: Neethana Antha Kuyil
desc: A woman vows to seek revenge against those who murdered her husband. Later, she murders Veerababu, an evil landlord, and seeks refuge in a woman's house with her son.

title: Nilaave Vaa
desc: Siluvai, a Christian man, wants to get married to Sangeetha, a Hindu woman who is already engaged to Siva. Her father is against their union, but Siva decides to help them.

title: Paarai
desc: Durai Raj, a lorry driver, has only one friend, Jayaram. However, when his friend dies, Durai Raj strives to support his family.
